title: ABC 4 - hol-pietro
description: Hol na piętrze — przy tarasie. Halinka i Czesław prezentują odbudowany dom kultury. A: render Blender; B: dodanie postaci i korekta skali; C: fotograficzne materiały i światło. Statyczne ujęcie 4 s. Źródła i pełna sekwencja promptów w generation-history.

prompts.image:
Stage C. Make this exact image B look like a real architectural documentary photograph by changing ONLY material microtexture and light response. Keep both people exactly identical: faces, clothes, walking poses, sizes, coordinates and shadows' contact points. Preserve every architectural edge, glazing mullion, railing, door handle, ceiling light and the complete framing. Nothing may be added, removed or moved.
Real fine painted plaster, satin aluminum and glass, subtle natural oak door grain, realistic seamless light-gray matte floor with no tile joints or invented panels. Preserve the indistinct gray exterior exactly; do not add trees, skyline, buildings or landscape. Maintain the existing soft overcast window illumination and gentle warm ceiling light, realistic reflected light, natural skin and fabric texture. No new wall seams or skirting that wasn't present.
Full-frame 28mm f/4 documentary photographic response, focus on the two people, subtle optical falloff and very mild foreground glazing softness; room remains readable. 1/100s ISO800 WB4300K, restrained highlights, fine sensor grain. Do not change camera position, angle, crop or field of view. Same 16:9.
